name: Poona Creek

port.name: Tin Can Bay (Snapper Creek)
port.datum: LAT at Tin Can Bay (Snapper Creek)

lines.name: Poona Creek
lines.limitSrc: DEM: river surface/bed ≥4 m from 5.1 km (Copernicus 90 m DEM via Open-Meteo, 3 km rolling min)

M.name: Mouth (≈ MSQ Big Tuan)
M.src: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary place: HW +55 min, LW +65 min on Bundaberg (Burnett Heads); converted to Tin Can Bay (Snapper Creek) via fitted harmonics; planes MHWS 2.21 MHWN 1.76 MLWN 0.90 MLWS 0.46 m LAT — place is 5.5 km from this mouth

M.name: Tidal limit (est.)
M.src: Generic extrapolation 5.1 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of all calibrated QLD places/gauges in this region (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (water-starts-rising, like upper Baffle)

confidence.why: short creek with an official reference at the mouth; upper reach extrapolated

sources: Geometry: OpenStreetMap waterways (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)
